notes.title: v0.50 Part I - Demon Hunter | New Character, Cards, Animations & More!
notes.content:
Hey, fearless players! The wait’s over—v0.50 Part I - Demon Hunter is here, and it’s all about action! 

We’ve unleashed 9 wicked new cards, 2 brand-new dungeons with a killer theme, and a fresh trader mechanic to spice up your strategies. Meet a new character joining the fight, enjoy new animations juicing up old scenes and a brand new highly requested scene, a new special Easter outfit for extra flair and catch slick new visual effects—plus a slew of fixes to keep it tight. Get your deck ready!

👤Characters:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Introduced the "Mysterious Trader", a new trader character to spice up the dungeon exploration.


🌶️Scenes:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Introduced the Maya Defeated Scene.


🎃 Animations:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Added 3 new animations to existing scenes for extra flair.
 Introduced the new highly requested and fully animated "Maya Defeated" scene, complete with 6 variant animations and audio. 


🏹 Deckbuilding:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Added 9 new cards, including 6 steamy erotic cards.
 Exclusive cards are now available in the Mysterious Trader’s shop.
 Added new cards that are unlocked after a player’s death.
 Chime’s shop now stocks exclusive cards too.


🌿Environment:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Added two repeatable snow dungeons to explore.


🛠️ Mechanics:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Implemented a trading system with the Mysterious Trader.
 Unlock 13 unique trading options with the Mysterious Trader.
 Added a dungeon variety system to ensure each repeatable dungeon feels fresh by avoiding back-to-back repeats of the same layout.


🎲 Misc:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Added Maya’s "Bunny Girl" outfit, an Easter-themed special that grants a unique combat effect.
 Introduced tutorial screens for dungeons, portals, the Mysterious Trader, wardrobe, and death rewards to guide players better.
 Enhanced visual effects across the game, including the main menu and dungeons, for a richer experience.
 Revamped Blaze and Geo’s location with a bold new color scheme and striking visual effects.
 Added a new app on Maya’s phone linking to our upcoming game’s page—stay tuned!
 Included new sound effects for dungeons and the Mysterious Trader’s menu.


⚙️ Fixes:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Gave the Cumblaster card a sleek visual upgrade and correctly classified it as a Cursed card.
 Updated all DLCs to match the current game version for seamless compatibility.
 Removed the namebox during thoughts or narration when no dialogue is present.
 Added page numbers to gallery screens for easier navigation.
 Improved UI scrolling with drag, mouse wheel, and arrow key support.
 Ensured Armor effects display correctly at the start of battles.
 Adjusted Maya’s positioning on the wardrobe screen for better visuals.
 Fixed a dungeon bug that teleported Maya to a random dungeon when clicking the home button.
 Resolved a progression-blocking bug after defeating lesser demons in the first side quest.
 Tweaked the Chaos Breaker card to apply 1 Vulnerable stack (down from 2), as intended.
 Replaced the vibrator prop in the "White Object" side quest with a higher-quality model—no more pixelation!
 Overhauled the changelog menu to better showcase game updates.
 Restored missing audio in Chime’s store.
 Squashed various minor bugs for a smoother experience.
 Fixed an issue with the Mysterious Trader where only the Rare Card appeared as a reward; the missing  Greed Card is now included.
 Resolved display issues with the new textbox on Android devices.
 Updated the credits screen.
 Added new content to the art pack.
 Resolved an issue where the deck was not appearing in the inventory in older game saves.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Curious about the romance and visual novel bits? They’re coming, don’t worry! We split this update into two parts to lock in the combat and deckbuilding now, while gathering your feedback to make Part II’s steamy, heartfelt scenes even better. It’s already in the works, so stay tuned for that next big drop. Why the split? More focus, more polish, and a bigger punch overall. How’s the new combat hitting you? Crush those demons and let us know in the comments—we’re stoked to hear your take! 

And while you’re here, don’t miss out on our next big project: Past Mistakes - Act I, hitting Steam in 2025! Experience the story of Cyrus, a regular guy with a lot to answer for in his past, as he gets a rare second chance to heal and repair his past mistakes. Add it to your wishlist now and be the first to dive into this emotional adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3302660/Past_Mistakes___Act_I/

Thank you so much for playing our game and for the amazing support!

notes.title: Futariuum’s Gate V0.45 (Christmas Update)
notes.content:
Howdy all, Futariuum’s Gate followers!

We’ve got a bite-sized update for you all as a stocking stuffer for the holiday season! We’ve received a lot of feedback from the release of v0.40, and as we continue to work hard on the next content-rich update of Futariuum’s Gate, we wanted to show our gratitude with a handful of stuff for you to enjoy!

📝 Features Overview:
- A brand-new, Christmas-themed outfit for Maya, which can be used in battle!
- A new Boss Demon, called “Blaze”. Defeat her burning desire and check out her new scorching-hot sex scene!
- Six new dungeons, with randomized layouts. Boss Demon “Blaze” can appear in these, as well as all the other Demons you’ve fought in the previous versions!
- 2 new cards for you to use and one as an unplayable card belonging to the Boss Demon “Blaze”!
- Chime now has banter and a functional store. Speak to Chime and see short conversations to get a little look into her personality and see what she has to negotiate!

🔎 Changelog:

⚡ Character ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added Boss Demon Blaze.

⚡ Cards ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added 3 new cards.

⚡ Cards ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added 3 new cards.

⚡ Scenes ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added a new scene: Maya x Blaze (3 VARIANTS).

⚡ UI ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added the complete interface for Chime’s Store, organized by categories (buy, remove, and trade).

⚡Dungeon⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added 6 new repeatable dungeons, each with several variants.
- Added a death system to the repeatable dungeons: now there's a chance that when you die, you'll unlock new cards.
- Introduced the outfit mechanic: Each outfit now provides specific bonuses for Maya.
- The demon boss Blaze has been strengthened: Their attack power, block, and HP have been increased.
- Made several fixes to the previous dungeons.

⚡ Animation ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added an animation to Chime’s portrait in her store.

⚡ Special ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added Maya’s Christmas special outfit for use during combat.

⚡ Misc ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- - Added a “remove” button to Chime’s Store.
- Added the repeatable dungeon "Abyssal Cave" icon to the navigation map.
- Added a “clear!” icon to the navigation map.
- Added a “buy” button to Chime’s Store.
- Added a “trade” button to Chime’s Store, along with icons for this section.
- Added a quest notification icon above the quest menu icon, which appears whenever a new quest is added.
- Added a visual slash/attack effect that appears on the character sprite whenever a character takes damage.
- Added a quick access button to transport the player to Chime’s Store.
- Added dialogues for Chime.
- Added more transition animations for Maya’s portrait.
- Added 4 new achievements (Steam only).
- Added keyboard-only functionality. Use the "D" key to open the deck menu.

⚡ Fixes ⚡
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
- Added a reward for the first Lesser Demon.
- Made several fixes to previous cards.
- The Thunder Spear card has been balanced, now dealing 14 damage with a cost of 50 mana, and the cost is displayed on the card.
- The uses of the Sanguination card will now reset before each battle.
- Belial Nerf:
    - In her first battle on normal difficulty, Belial's HP has been reduced from 125 to 100.
    - In her second battle, her attack power has been lowered from 15 to 14, but only if the difficulty is not set to easy.
- The battle now ends with a new transition and visual effect before going to the rewards screen.
- Added missing stars to some of the cards.
- Fixed card label from “attack” to “skill” for the Earthquake and Chaos Breaker cards.
- Fixed keymaps for the dorms.
- Updated the walkthrough (Utility Pack DLC).
- Updated the Art Pack DLC.
- Made several fixes throughout the game.

We’re still trucking along with the next, larger update for the game, including the content for Maya’s Sphere that the community has voted on, along with much more. Check out the new update and stay tuned for more!

Love, Gloomy Washer.

notes.title: Futariuum’s Gate Early Access Launch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119686/b3c88e4262bce83e31705bf3a2eec47b0b08d438.png

Howdy all, Futariuum’s Gate followers!

Today’s the day! The Early Access build for Futariuum’s Gate is officially out now on Steam, along with its additional content and add-on packs!

Hoo, boy. This release is a big one. We’ve painstakingly created and refined insane amounts of new content for you all to enjoy. For those who have seen our previous progress, this new release includes:


 A brand-new card battle system, with deck building and exciting turn-based battles! 20 cards are included in this release, ranging wildly in power and effects!
 Also completely new, dungeon exploration gameplay! We’ve included three dungeons in this first release and we intend to add many more!
 2 new demons to fight in the dungeons, with their own new sex scenes and CGs!
 New plot progression, including the introduction of 3 new characters that will become very important to the story from here on out!
 New world events with additional spicy CGs!
 A new side quest with, you guessed it, a juicy CG scene at the end!
 And much more!


And for anyone new to Futariuum’s Gate, you’re in for a hell of an experience for our first release on Steam. Up to this point, we’ve managed to cram a whole bunch of content into the game up to this point, including:


 90+ exciting, beautiful and very lewd CG scenes and variants!
 2 lewd animated CGs!
 Around 6 hours of dense visual novel story content!
 3 characters with the beginnings of their own story arcs and social events in Maya’s Sphere, plus a whole bunch of others in the works!
 5 demons to fight so far, with many more planned on the way!
 A prologue and a completed first episode, following the intended roadmap for our game’s multi-chapter story! 


This content-heavy update is the fruit of our labor over the past few months as we’ve worked hard to deliver new exciting content, while also addressing the feedback and concerns our players have given us.

Purchase the game on Steam and let us know what you think! We can’t thank you enough for all the support you’ve given us these past weeks as we’ve pushed ourselves further than ever for this update. Thank you so much!!

Love, Gloomy Washer.
